posts.title: riotermjs: Rio's terminal engine, now on the web
posts.description: Rio's Rust VT engine compiled to WebAssembly, published as rioterm on npm. Faster than xterm.js on every metric we measured, and already running inside Lovable.

posts.title: rio-vt and librio: Rio's terminal engine, now embeddable
posts.description: Rio's terminal core is now a standalone, dependency-light engine you can embed anywhere: rio-vt as a safe Rust crate and librio as a C ABI.

posts.title: What's coming next?
posts.description: A look at what's coming in the next major version of Rio terminal.
